patch.intent: 已完成三家材料差异、可推进工作、依赖语义变化与下游验收门槛分析；影响说明绑定 RULES.md r2、规则 delta 和本地验证证据。

acceptance.criterion: 说明三家伙伴的材料差异和可推进工作。
保留实际产物与来源引用，无法确认的内容显式说明。

evidence.command: rtk proxy ruby -rjson -rdigest -e 'doc="deliverables/songguo-change-impact.md"; body=File.read(doc); required=["接入开放日期尚未确认","资料核对窗口由两家缩为一家","资料齐全的申请优先","正式依赖拓扑仍是","SG-DIFF → SG-DEPEND → SG-PLAN → SG-REVIEW → SG-DELIVER","溪桥","云岭","南园","不是业务批准记录","受影响的验收条件"]; missing=required.reject { |item| body.include?(item) }; abort("missing content: #{missing.join(",")}") unless missing.empty?; refs=["RULES.md","PLAN.md","work-ledger.yaml","materials/initial-plan.md","materials/partner-requests.csv","DELIVERABLES.md","deliverables/songguo-source-versions.md",".work-receipts/awr-sg-depend-rule-delta.json"]; absent=refs.reject { |item| File.file?(item) }; abort("missing source: #{absent.join(",")}") unless absent.empty?; abort("deliverable hash mismatch") unless Digest::SHA256.file(doc).hexdigest=="6792b22621c6364fd3802b5a7e5c9552710f418df917ffdac819dcb0d5fe3beb"; abort("rules hash mismatch") unless Digest::SHA256.file("RULES.md").hexdigest=="bbd2f4b5241b1c3fbdd774c9c749464960beaa47ac1d70501f2ddcdae441499a"; delta=JSON.parse(File.read(".work-receipts/awr-sg-depend-rule-delta.json")); rule_change=delta.dig("delta","events","source_changes").find { |change| change.dig("after","domain")=="rules" }; abort("missing rules delta") unless rule_change && rule_change.dig("before","revision")==1 && rule_change.dig("after","revision")==2 && rule_change.fetch("changed_entities").any? { |entity| entity["external_key"].end_with?("#revision") && entity["latest_action"]=="added" }; abort("review boundary violated") if File.exist?("deliverables/sg-independent-review.md") || File.exist?("deliverables/sg-delivery.md"); puts "SG-DEPEND verification passed"'
evidence.summary: Locally verified change-impact report covering the one-partner window, complete-material priority, three partner preparation states, unchanged dependency edges, and tightened downstream acceptance gates.
